Fix registration issues where object IDs don't match their kind's expected
format.

This command helps resolve ID format mismatches by either:
  - Updating the ID prefix configuration to accept alternative formats (--fix)
  - Providing guidance on how to fix the object ID

  Fix registration for a specific object
  zqk utility fix-registration ADR-001
  Fix registration for all objects of a kind
  zqk utility fix-registration --kind decision
  Fix all registration issues
  zqk utility fix-registration --all
  Update config to accept found prefixes (dry run)
  zqk utility fix-registration --all --fix --dry-run

Usage:
  zqk utility fix-registration [id...] [flags]

Flags:
      --all           Fix all registration issues in the system
      --dry-run       With --fix, show what would be added without writing
      --fix           Update id_prefixes config to accept discovered prefixes
      --kind string   Fix registration for all objects of the specified kind
  -q, --quiet         Only show errors and fix summary
